abstract: Primary gastric choriocarcinoma is an extremely rare and poor prognosis. A 73-year-old man who had appetite loss was admitted to our hospital in May 2006. Abdominal CT showed tumor measured 9x7 cm in size between residual stomach and pancreas. Gastrointestinal endoscopy revealed that gastric posterior wall was compressed and soft necrotic elevated tissue with coagulation. Endoscopic biopsy specimens showed poorly differentiated adenocarcinoma. Total gastrectomy with D2 lymphadenectomy, distal pancreatectomy, splenectomy, and partial resection of transverse colon were performed. Histological findings of resected specimens showed choriocarcinoma which demonstrated reactivity against anti-hCG antibody by immunohistochemical staining. Forty five days after the operation, skin metastasis appeared, and he died of this disease 60 days after the operation.
abstract_ja: 原発性胃絨毛癌は極めて稀で予後不良である。73歳の男性が食欲不振のため当院を受診した。2006年5月の腹部コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で、残存胃と膵臓の間に9×7cmの腫瘍を認めた。消化管内視鏡では、胃後壁が圧迫され、凝固を伴う軟らかい壊死性の隆起性組織を認めた。内視鏡生検標本では低分化腺癌を示した。胃全摘術（D2リンパ節郭清）、膵体尾部切除、脾摘、横行結腸の部分切除を施行した。切除標本の組織学的所見は絨毛癌を示し、免疫組織化学染色で抗ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)抗体に反応した。手術の45日後に皮膚転移が出現し、手術の60日後に本疾患により死亡した。
